heading: Wave 14: Convex backend helpers

briefs.focus: convex 1.45.0 as installed (node_modules/convex/package.json). Read the type definitions, not memory: node_modules/convex/dist/esm-types/server/database.d.ts (table-first db.get/patch/delete(table, id) overloads that new code should prefer, db.system.get('_scheduled_functions', id) for runState in P205), query.d.ts (withIndex, take, unique, first, collect, paginate ordering and limits), pagination.d.ts (PaginationResult, PaginationOptions for P204's clampPageSize/deniedPage), values/errors.d.ts (ConvexError data payload and how object vs string data appear in .message, for P195's accountMerge change) and values/validator.d.ts (Infer, v.union). Confirm for P198 whether ctx.db.query(table) with a union-typed table name type-checks .withIndex('by_user_character', ...) when every member has that index, and whether returning Doc<T> for a generic T needs the single cast. Confirm transaction semantics: Promise.all of independent reads inside a mutation (P195, P289), sequential deletes, read-set/OCC conflicts from a wider by_map range read (P215), per-mutation document read/write limits (P196, P215), and what `convex codegen --typecheck disable` regenerates in convex/_generated when modules are added, moved or deleted (P199, P201, P204). zod 4.5.4 as installed (node_modules/zod/v4/classic type definitions), imported as 'zod' and bundled into the Convex runtime. For P208: sharing a raw field-shape object between z.object (strips unknown keys, used by Convex request schemas) and z.strictObject (rejects unknown keys, used by Next response schemas); spreading a shape into a larger object versus .extend; typing an inferred type from a shape (z.infer<z.ZodObject<typeof shape>>) versus z.infer of a finished schema; z.input versus z.output with `satisfies` at a call site; .int() safe-integer bounds and .nonnegative() in v4. Read first: src/lib/id-schemas.ts (positiveIdSchema to reuse for characterId), src/data/location-tracking/merge.ts, src/data/location-tracking/schema.ts, src/data/location-tracking/constants.ts, convex/httpAccountMerge.ts, convex/httpLocation.ts, convex/httpEngine.ts, convex/lib/httpAuth.ts (authorizedJsonAction takes z.ZodType<T>), src/data/convex/api-contract.ts, src/data/convex/leave-door.ts and src/transport/endpoint.ts (why api-contract.ts cannot be imported by Convex).

fallow 3.22.0 as installed: node_modules/fallow/README.md, schema.json, issue-registry.json and skills/fallow, read against the repo's .fallowrc.json and the fallow:static script in package.json. Cover the rules this wave trips: unused-exports and unused-types with ignoreExportsUsedInFile false (un-exporting stopSync, deleting UserCharacterIndexedTable, TablePurgeResult, MAP_JUMP_BOOKKEEPING_PURGE_BATCH, getPresence, findCharacterLocation), duplicate-exports (no re-export of TRACKED_CHARACTERS_PER_MAP_USER_CAP from mapTrackingOptIn), circular-dependencies between convex/lib and root modules (new lib/mapAuthoringEvents must not import ../mapAuthoringCollapse), boundary rules (convex may import data, lib, platform/auth, platform/esi; src/data children are autoDiscover zones that may not import each other except data/eve-data), dupes in weak mode at 50 tokens or 5 lines, health limits (cyclomatic 20, cognitive 15, CRAP 30) and coverage-gaps with requireAllFiles for new modules. Explain how `fallow guard <files>` reports a boundary check for a proposed home.

waveCautions: Line refs drifted since e5b7b17 (readPairRows is now mapJumpAuthoring.ts:79); re-open every site. Unlisted overlaps: P195 steps 5 and 9 already do P289 steps 1-2, and P195 step 8 does P208's MERGE_TRACKING_LIMIT move; land each once, record the residual. P195, P198, P200 and P202 all edit mapScanApply.requireTrackedSystem, and P195's takeIndexedOrThrow conflicts with P200's non-throwing readUserMapTracking there: keep takeIndexedOrThrow and have P200 only repoint the cap import. Hotspots: accountMerge, mapScanSelection, mapAuthoringCollapse, mapChainCleanup. New, moved (git mv) or deleted modules (P199, P201, P204) need modules.setup.ts, their own tests (coverage-gaps), and `pnpm exec convex codegen --typecheck disable`. Contract modules Convex imports must not import transport, next, drizzle or node. Keep removers sequential. Preserve every error code and detail; assert with expectConvexErrorCode. Red-to-green tests and PR notes for behaviour changes: P215 (medium risk, orphan tracking revoked), P195 (merge errors gain codes), P207 (no-op writes skipped), P208 (negative stamps rejected), P206 (to-door compare). Keep source pins green: mapAuthoringSweep.test.ts:524-532, mapScanSubscriptions.test.ts:190-193, mapChain.test.ts:499-610. Notes left by earlier waves: Convex enum validators are built from their data-zone tuples and the TS types inferred from validators (P261); bearerMatches is shared through src/lib/bearer.ts and Convex answers a logged 500 when CONVEX_SERVICE_SECRET is unset (P210); SITE_URL is read through readAppOrigin (P211); the convex lint block rejects raw process.env reads.
